title: Use the shared meaning of WMBT (advisory semantic anchor)

facts.note: Any task text that uses or asks about the term WMBT; independent of phase, operation or artifact location.
Optional, non-exclusive extra trigger: a diff-level observer detecting a WMBT entry added or changed in any artifact. Not required for activation.

fires: Someone asks what a WMBT is or how one is shaped (no diff involved).
A planner writes or revises a WMBT, in any artifact.
A doc, review or acceptance discussion uses the term WMBT and needs its meaning.
doesNotFire: Work that neither uses nor touches the WMBT concept (e.g. implementing code against acceptances with no reference to WMBTs).
Verifier runs looking for findings: this anchor emits no findings itself; the referenced rules do.

given: The term WMBT (What Must Be True) is used, asked about, or authored, in any context
then: Use this one meaning: a falsifiable statement of a single outcome that must hold for an artifact — scoped to one object of control along one dimension, direction, and lens — declared with an id and a statement, and paired with the acceptances that prove it, including at least one smoke acceptance.
prefer: For the enforceable parts, follow the referenced rules: planner.wmbt.shape (id, statement, proving artifacts), planner.wmbt.object-of-control, planner.wmbt.dimension-/direction-/lens-selection and planner.wmbt.splitting-rules (single axis), planner.wmbt.statement-template, planner.wmbt.must-have-smoke-acceptance.
avoid: Using WMBT for an unfalsifiable or multi-outcome statement.
Treating this anchor as a validator; compliance is checked through the enforceable nodes that require this anchor.
why: A WMBT needs one stable meaning so every WMBT rule checks the same concept. This anchor is advisory: it enforces nothing directly and is transitively protected by the rule nodes that require it.
evidence: No direct check on this node; compliance is established by the enforceable nodes that require this anchor: planner.wmbt.shape, planner.wmbt.object-of-control, planner.wmbt.dimension-selection, planner.wmbt.direction-selection, planner.wmbt.lens-selection, planner.wmbt.splitting-rules, planner.wmbt.statement-template, planner.wmbt.must-have-smoke-acceptance.
Reviewer may confirm that uses of the term WMBT match the definition in then.
verifier_detail: Advisory semantic anchor: a definitional node that gives the artifact a stable meaning but is not itself bound to a validator; it is transitively protected by the enforceable constraint/rule nodes that require it. No detector should report findings against this node directly.

Term decomposition: wmbt -> {well-shaped, single-object-of-control, single-axis, statement-formed, smoke-covered}. well-shaped = declares its id, its statement, and the artifacts that prove the statement (planner.wmbt.shape); single-object-of-control = scoped to exactly one object of control (planner.wmbt.object-of-control); single-axis = one dimension, one direction, one lens (planner.wmbt.dimension-selection, planner.wmbt.direction-selection, planner.wmbt.lens-selection, planner.wmbt.splitting-rules); statement-formed = follows the statement template (planner.wmbt.statement-template); smoke-covered = has at least one smoke acceptance (planner.wmbt.must-have-smoke-acceptance).
